children: The level of cash held by fund managers rose to 3.9% in September from 3.5% in August, according to the latest Bank of America global fund manager survey. This finding comes as the survey also shows investor sentiment weakened in September, after optimism seen in August. "Investor sentiment pulled back from the very bullish August survey (the 3rd most bullish survey since 2022) to the least bullish in 3 months." (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
